questions.q: What does “afford” mean?
o: Have enough money to buy something
Sell something at a low price
Save money in a safe place
Borrow something for a short time
questions.e: « afford » veut dire : avoir les moyens de payer quelque chose.

questions.q: What does “borrow” mean?
o: Give something for a short time
Take something and return it later
questions.e: « borrow » veut dire : emprunter (prendre puis rendre).

questions.q: What does “crowded” mean?
questions.e: « crowded » veut dire : bondé, plein de monde.

questions.q: What does “deliver” mean?
o: Take something to a person or place
questions.e: « deliver » veut dire : livrer, apporter à une personne ou à un endroit.

questions.q: What does “earn” mean?
questions.e: « earn » veut dire : gagner (de l'argent en travaillant).

questions.q: What does “lend” mean?
o: Take something and return it later
Give something for a short time

questions.q: What does “protect” mean?
What does “save” mean in “save money”?
questions.e: « save » veut dire : économiser, garder de l'argent pour plus tard.

questions.q: What does “repair” mean?
What does “waste” mean?
o: Use carelessly or without good reason

questions.q: What does “reach” mean in “reach the village”?
o: Build a road in the village
questions.e: « reach » veut dire : atteindre, arriver à.

questions.q: What does “improve” mean?
What does “avoid” mean?
What does “choose” mean?
What does “journey” mean?
o: A trip from one place to another

questions.q: Who is a “customer”?
o: A person who teaches a class

questions.q: What is “medicine”?
o: A tool used to build a house
A place where people buy food

questions.q: What is a “schedule”?
o: A list of things to buy
A plan that shows times and activities
questions.e: « schedule » veut dire : emploi du temps, programme.

questions.q: What does “reduce” mean?
What does “raise” mean in “raise the price”?
questions.e: « raise » veut dire : augmenter, faire monter.

questions.q: What does “peaceful” mean?
o: Calm, with little or no violence

questions.q: What does “honest” mean?
What is “advice”?
o: A suggestion about what to do
A rule that must be obeyed

questions.q: What does “confident” mean?
o: Sure about your ability or decision
questions.e: « confident » veut dire : sûr de soi, confiant.

questions.q: What does “apologize” mean?
What is an “appointment”?
o: A planned meeting at a set time

questions.q: What does “available” mean?
o: Free to be used or to meet

questions.q: What does “complain” mean?
o: Say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory

questions.q: What does “delay” mean as a verb?
What is “equipment”?
o: Tools or objects needed for an activity

questions.q: What is a weather “forecast”?
What does “independent” mean?
o: Able to act or work without help

questions.q: What is a “neighbourhood”?
o: The area around where people live

questions.q: What is an “opportunity”?
o: A good chance to do something

questions.q: What does “ordinary” mean?
What is “permission”?
What does “prepare” mean?
questions.e: « prepare » veut dire : préparer, se préparer.

questions.q: What does “receipt” mean in a shop?
o: A paper or message proving payment
questions.e: « receipt » veut dire : reçu, ticket de caisse.

questions.q: What does “recommend” mean?
o: Suggest something as a good choice

questions.q: What does “reliable” mean?
What does “responsible” mean?
o: Expected to take care of a duty

questions.q: What does “similar” mean?
What is a “solution” to a problem?
What does “survive” mean?
o: Stay alive or continue to exist

questions.q: What does “valuable” mean?
o: Worth a lot or very useful
questions.e: « valuable » veut dire : précieux, de grande valeur.

questions.q: Who is a “volunteer”?
o: A person who offers to help without pay
A worker who sets the price
A visitor who asks for a refund
A person who buys every ticket

questions.q: What does “fortunately” mean?
o: In a lucky or positive way

questions.q: What does “environment” mean?
What is the French for “borrow”?
What is the French for “lend”?
What is the French for “appointment”?
What is the French for “crowded”?
What is the French for “improve”?
What is the French for “avoid”?
What is the French for “advice”?
What is the French for “journey”?
What is the French for “healthy”?
questions.e: « healthy » se traduit par « en bonne santé ».

questions.q: What is the French for “careful”?
What is the French for “instead”?
questions.e: « instead » se traduit par « à la place ».

questions.q: What is the French for “repair”?
What is the French for “share”?
What is the French for “available”?
What is the French for “quietly”?
questions.e: « quietly » se traduit par « sans bruit ».

questions.q: What is the French for “return” in “Please return the book”?
What is the French for “succeed”?
What is the French for “waste” in “Don't waste water”?
What is the French for “reliable”?
What is the French for “remind”?
What is the French for “promise”?
What is the French for “neighbourhood”?
What is the French for “reduce”?
What is the French for “permission”?
In “You can borrow my umbrella,” what does borrow mean?
o: take it and return it later
questions.e: Borrow veut dire emprunter quelque chose puis le rendre.

questions.q: In “Try to avoid the muddy path,” what does avoid mean?
questions.e: Avoid veut dire éviter ou rester loin de.

questions.q: In “They discovered a small lake,” what does discovered mean?
questions.e: Discover veut dire découvrir, trouver pour la première fois.

questions.q: In “Reading every day can improve your English,” what does improve mean?
questions.e: Improve veut dire rendre meilleur ou s’améliorer.

questions.q: In “It is likely to rain this evening,” what does likely mean?
In “We need to reduce the noise,” what does reduce mean?
In “The purpose of the meeting is to plan a trip,” what does purpose mean?
questions.e: Purpose veut dire but ou raison.

questions.q: In “Please gather the books after class,” what does gather mean?
In “He wears ordinary clothes to school,” what does ordinary mean?
questions.e: Ordinary veut dire ordinaire ou habituel.

questions.q: In “The walls protect the garden from wind,” what does protect mean?
questions.e: Protect veut dire protéger, garder en sécurité.

questions.q: In “Please continue reading the story,” what does continue mean?
In “We walked instead of taking the bus,” what does instead of mean?
questions.e: Instead of veut dire au lieu de.

questions.q: In “This is a local market,” what does local mean?
questions.e: Local veut dire du coin, de cette région.

questions.q: In “I cannot afford a new phone,” what does afford mean?
questions.e: Afford veut dire avoir les moyens de payer.

questions.q: In “She refused to open the door,” what does refused mean?
questions.e: Refuse veut dire refuser, dire non.

questions.q: In “The journey took three hours,” what does journey mean?
questions.e: Journey veut dire voyage ou trajet.

questions.q: In “Our neighbourhood has a new library,” what does neighbourhood mean?
In “A crowd waited outside the stadium,” what does crowd mean?
questions.e: Crowd veut dire foule, grand groupe de personnes.

questions.q: In “We should protect the environment,” what does environment mean?
questions.e: Environment veut dire environnement, le monde naturel qui nous entoure.

questions.q: In “Please be patient while I find your book,” what does patient mean?
questions.e: Patient veut dire capable d’attendre calmement.

questions.q: In “My aunt gave me useful advice,” what does advice mean?
In “This job is a good opportunity,” what does opportunity mean?
In “The team hopes to succeed,” what does succeed mean?
questions.e: Succeed veut dire réussir, atteindre son but.

questions.q: In “We should check the information before sharing it,” what does check mean?
In Kayar, the fishermen go out to sea in a long wooden boat called a ___.
questions.e: Canoe = pirogue, le bateau en bois des pêcheurs. Truck = camion, cart = charrette.

questions.q: The fishermen throw their ___ into the sea to catch sardines.
questions.e: Net = filet de pêche. Shovel = pelle, bucket = seau, broom = balai.

questions.q: When the boats come back to Kayar, women buy the ___ on the beach and sell it at the market.
questions.e: The catch = la prise, le poisson pêché. Harvest et crop concernent les champs, herd = troupeau.

questions.q: The sea is calm today: there are no big ___.
questions.e: Wave = vague. Shell = coquillage, sail = voile, shore = rivage.

questions.q: A ___ is a place on the coast where boats can stop and stay safely.
questions.e: Harbour (ou port) = port, abri pour les bateaux.

questions.q: At the end of the rainy season, farmers ___ their millet.
questions.e: Harvest = récolter. On récolte le mil après l'hivernage.

questions.q: When it does not rain for a very long time, there is a ___.
questions.e: Drought = sécheresse. Flood = inondation, tide = marée.

questions.q: After the heavy rain, many streets in Dakar were under water. There was a ___.
In the school garden, we pull out the ___ because they take water from our vegetables.
questions.e: Weeds = mauvaises herbes. Seeds = graines, fence = clôture.

questions.q: Before planting, we put ___ in the soil to make it richer.
questions.e: Fertilizer = engrais. Le compost et le fumier sont des engrais naturels.

questions.q: Thanks to the new well, farmers can ___ their fields even in the dry season.
questions.e: Irrigate = irriguer, apporter de l'eau aux cultures.

questions.q: Cows, goats and sheep raised on a farm are called ___.
A ___ looks after sheep and goats when they eat in the fields.
In the rainy season, many farmers around Kébémer grow millet and ___.
questions.e: Groundnuts (ou peanuts) = arachides, une culture très importante au Sénégal.

questions.q: At Sandaga market, you can ___ with the seller to get a lower price.
This bag costs only 500 francs. It's really ___!
questions.e: Cheap = bon marché, pas cher. Expensive = cher.

questions.q: I gave the seller 1,000 francs for a 700-franc mango juice, so he gave me 300 francs ___.
questions.e: Change = la monnaie qu'on vous rend.

questions.q: The seller puts the rice on the ___ to know how many kilos it weighs.
questions.e: Scales = balance. Shelf = étagère, stove = réchaud.

questions.q: A small table or place where someone sells things in a market is a ___.
questions.e: Stall = étal, petite place de vente. Stool = tabouret.

questions.q: At the end of every month, the workers of the factory receive their ___.
The shop has a 20% ___ today, so everything is cheaper.
questions.e: Discount = réduction, remise. Debt = dette, loan = prêt.

questions.q: Please wait in the ___ like everybody else; don't push!
He owes his cousin 10,000 francs. He has a ___.
Our ___ shows that we have English on Monday and Thursday.
Fatou was not at school yesterday because she was sick. She was ___.
Before the BFEM, students ___ their lessons every evening.
The person in charge of a school is the ___.
If you don't know a word, look it up in your ___.
questions.e: Dictionary = dictionnaire. Look up a word = chercher un mot.

questions.q: I got a good ___ in my maths test: 16 out of 20.
questions.e: Mark (UK) ou grade (US) = note. Attention : a note = un petit mot écrit.

questions.q: Students who always arrive on time are ___.
Please ___ attention to the board.
I always ___ my homework after dinner.
questions.e: On dit do homework : faire ses devoirs.

questions.q: Don't worry, everybody ___ mistakes when they learn a language.
questions.e: On dit make a mistake : faire une erreur.

questions.q: Can you ___ a photo of our football team?
questions.e: On dit take a photo (et non make a photo).

questions.q: Moussa sat the exam last week and ___ it with 15 out of 20.
questions.e: Pass an exam = réussir un examen. Faux ami : « passer un examen » = take ou sit an exam.

questions.q: Tomorrow I will ___ my English exam. I hope I'll pass it!
questions.e: Take an exam = passer un examen. Pass = réussir.

questions.q: Moussa's temperature is 39°C. He has a ___.
Sleep under a mosquito net to protect yourself from ___.
questions.e: Malaria = paludisme, transmis par les moustiques.

questions.q: The doctor wrote a ___ so I can buy the medicine at the pharmacy.
questions.e: Prescription = ordonnance. Faux ami : recipe = recette de cuisine.

questions.q: A person who looks after sick people in a hospital is a ___.
I ate too much thiéboudienne and now I have a ___.
questions.e: Stomach ache = mal au ventre. Earache = mal d'oreille.

questions.q: Children are ___ against measles at the health centre.
When you have a cold, you often ___ and need a tissue.
Awa's parents were very ___ when she won the reading competition.
He felt ___ after he lied to his best friend.
I'm always ___ before an exam; my hands shake.
questions.e: Nervous = anxieux, stressé. Attention : « énervé » se dit annoyed.

questions.q: Thank you so much for your help. I'm really ___.
The film was so long and slow that everybody in the room was ___.
questions.e: Bored = qui s'ennuie (la personne). Boring = ennuyeux (la chose).

questions.q: The match between Senegal and Cameroon was really ___! Everybody was on their feet.
questions.e: Exciting = passionnant (la chose). Excited = excité, enthousiaste (la personne).

questions.q: She was ___ because her team lost the final.
He is ___ of his brother's new phone; he wants one too.
When she saw that she had passed the BFEM, she felt ___.
My little brother is ___ of dogs; he runs away when he sees one.
questions.e: Be afraid of = avoir peur de. Be fond of = aimer bien.

questions.q: Ibrahima doesn't like speaking in front of the class; he is ___.
Our neighbour always shares her food with everybody. She is very ___.
questions.e: Generous = généreux. Selfish = égoïste, greedy = avide.

questions.q: He never helps at home and stays in bed all day. He is ___.
It's ___ to interrupt people when they are speaking.
A ___ person thinks only about himself or herself.
She studies every day and never gives up. She is ___.
He always says « please » and « thank you ». He is ___.
Our teacher is ___: she never accepts late homework.
The young wrestler was ___ and faced the champion without fear.
Each ___ paid 1,000 francs for the trip from Kébémer to Louga.
How much is the bus ___ to Dakar?
questions.e: Fare = prix d'un trajet (bus, taxi, train).

questions.q: Put your ___ on the roof of the bus before we leave.
Our car ___ on the road to Touba, so we waited for a mechanic.
The plane ___ from Dakar airport at 10 a.m. and landed in Paris six hours later.
Turn left at the ___, next to the mosque.
Our final ___ is Saint-Louis, but we will stop in Louga on the way.
The ___ of the train is at 8 a.m. and it arrives at noon.
We ___ very early in the morning to avoid the heat.
questions.e: Set off = partir, se mettre en route.

questions.q: The roads of Dakar are full of cars every morning; there is a big ___.
My father's sister's son is my ___.
questions.e: Le fils de ma tante est mon cousin.

questions.q: My sister's daughter is my ___.
My brother's son is my ___.
Awa and Adama were born on the same day to the same mother. They are ___.
My husband's mother is my ___.
questions.e: Mother-in-law = belle-mère (mère du conjoint). Stepmother = femme du père.

questions.q: A week after the birth, the family organized a naming ___ for the baby.
At Tabaski, many families buy a ___ for the sacrifice.
questions.e: Sheep = mouton. Le pluriel est aussi sheep.

questions.q: During the Grand Magal, millions of ___ travel to Touba.
We invited fifty ___ to my sister's wedding.
questions.e: Guest = invité. Host = celui qui reçoit.

questions.q: After lunch, my uncle always ___ ataya for the whole family.
questions.e: On dit make tea : préparer le thé.

questions.q: A good glass of ataya has a lot of ___ on top.
Please ___ the TV; nobody is watching it.
questions.e: Turn off = éteindre. Turn on = allumer.

questions.q: It's cold this morning. ___ your jacket before you go out.
questions.e: Put on = mettre (un vêtement). Take off = enlever.

questions.q: Can you ___ my little brother while I go to the market?
I'm ___ my keys. Have you seen them?
My grandfather ___ smoking ten years ago.
questions.e: Give up = arrêter, abandonner une habitude.

questions.q: I ___ at 6 a.m. every day to get ready for school.
I ___ in Mboro, but now I live in Dakar.
We have ___ sugar. Can you buy some at the boutique?
questions.e: Run out of = ne plus avoir de, être à court de.

questions.q: Can you ___ what time the match starts?
My uncle ___ from Italy last week after five years abroad.
In football, the ___ blows the whistle when a player commits a foul.
Sadio Mané ___ a goal in the last minute of the match.
questions.e: Score a goal = marquer un but.

questions.q: The match ended 1-1. It was a ___.
Senegal ___ Egypt on penalties in the final of the 2021 Africa Cup of Nations.
questions.e: Beat = battre un adversaire. Win = gagner un match ou une coupe.

questions.q: The Lions of Teranga ___ the cup, and the whole country celebrated.
questions.e: Win a cup = gagner une coupe. On ne dit pas beat a cup.

questions.q: The two wrestlers face each other in a big ___ in Dakar.
The ___ trains the players and chooses who will play.
Thousands of ___ sang and cheered for their team in the stadium.
A football match is played on a ___.
questions.e: Pitch = terrain de football. Court = terrain de basket ou de tennis, ring = ring de boxe.

questions.q: The goalkeeper ___ the ball with both hands.
Don't throw your ___ on the beach; put it in the bin.
Instead of throwing old bottles away, we can ___ them.
Smoke from cars and factories causes air ___.
questions.e: Pollution = pollution. Ne pas confondre avec population.

questions.q: Every year, the students of the Groupe Agricole ___ trees around the school.
When people ___ too many trees, the land becomes dry.
The Sahara is the largest hot ___ in the world.
Plastic bags are ___ for animals: goats and sheep sometimes eat them and get sick.
A ___ makes clothes, for example new boubous for Korité.
A ___ makes tables, doors and chairs out of wood.
A ___ works with metal and fire to make tools like hoes.
My motorbike doesn't start. I need a ___.
There is water everywhere in the bathroom. Call a ___!
A ___ writes articles for a newspaper or reports the news on the radio.
A ___ builds houses with bricks and cement.
A ___ defends people in court.
questions.e: Lawyer = avocat. Judge = juge, witness = témoin.

questions.q: The ___ sells meat at the market.
I go to the ___ to get my hair cut.
He lost his job and is looking for a new one. He is ___.
My grandfather stopped working at 60. He is now ___.
In Senegal, the dry, dusty wind that blows from the Sahara is called the ___.
questions.e: L'harmattan est un vent sec et chargé de poussière venant du Sahara.

questions.q: In August the air is hot and wet. It is very ___.
Take an umbrella; it's going to ___ heavily this afternoon.
questions.e: Rain = pleuvoir. Freeze = geler, melt = fondre.

questions.q: There is a lot of ___ this morning; drivers can't see far.
During the storm, we heard loud ___ and saw lightning.
After the rain, a beautiful ___ appeared in the sky with seven colours.
My phone battery is low. I need to ___ it.
You can ___ the Jàng app from the Play Store.
questions.e: Download = télécharger (vers son appareil). Upload = envoyer en ligne.

questions.q: Never tell anybody your ___; keep it secret.
There is no ___ in this part of the village, so I can't call you.
I ___ the photo by mistake, so now it's gone.
What is the opposite of « generous »?
questions.e: Mean = radin (et aussi méchant). C'est le contraire de generous.

questions.q: What is the opposite of « ancient »?
What is the opposite of « narrow »?
What is the opposite of « deep »?
What is the opposite of « rough »?
What is the opposite of « loose »?
questions.e: Loose = ample, desserré. Tight = serré. Ne pas confondre loose et lose (perdre).

questions.q: What is the opposite of « arrive »?
What is the opposite of « accept »?
What is the opposite of « increase »?
What is the opposite of « remember »?
What is the opposite of « dangerous »?
What is the opposite of « succeed »?
What is the opposite of « asleep »?
What is the opposite of « guilty »?
Which word means the same as « enormous »?
Which word means the same as « begin »?
Which word means the same as « furious »?
Which word means the same as « tidy »?
questions.e: Tidy et neat = bien rangé, ordonné.

questions.q: Which word means the same as the verb « complete »?
Which word means the same as « purchase »?
questions.e: Purchase = acheter (mot plus formel que buy).

questions.q: Which word means the same as « rapid »?
Which word means the same as « silly »?
Which word means the same as « frightened »?
What is the noun of « happy »?
questions.e: Le suffixe -ness forme un nom : happiness = le bonheur.

questions.q: Someone who does things without paying attention is ___.
questions.e: Le suffixe -less veut dire « sans » : careless = négligent.

questions.q: A person or company that gives jobs to workers is an ___.
questions.e: Employer = employeur. Employee = employé (celui qui travaille).

questions.q: What is the noun of « decide »?
Complete: I received an ___ to my cousin's wedding.
Which word means « not possible »?
questions.e: Devant un p, le préfixe négatif est souvent im- : impossible.

questions.q: Which word means « not honest »?
Which word means « not polite »?
What is the adjective of « danger »?
questions.e: Le suffixe -ous forme des adjectifs : dangerous.

questions.q: A person who plays the guitar is a ___.
questions.e: Le suffixe -ist indique une personne : guitarist, pianist, journalist.

questions.q: What is the noun of « strong »?
What is the adjective of « beauty »?
What is the noun of « free »?
Please ___ me the truth.
questions.e: Tell someone something ; say something (sans personne directement après).

questions.q: Our English teacher ___ us new words every week.
Be careful, don't ___ your phone in the car rapide!
The library is very ___: nobody is talking.
questions.e: Quiet = calme, silencieux. Quite = assez. Quit = quitter.

questions.q: Two men ___ the bank last night and took all the money.
questions.e: Rob a bank / a person ; steal an object.

questions.q: Someone ___ my bicycle while I was at the mosque.
We ___ a film on TV last night.
When you come to my house tomorrow, ___ your English notebook with you.
questions.e: Bring = apporter (vers l'endroit où se trouve la personne qui parle).

questions.q: The sun ___ in the east every morning.
questions.e: Rise = se lever (sans complément). Raise something = lever quelque chose.

questions.q: A good friend always ___ his promises.
questions.e: Keep a promise = tenir sa promesse.

questions.q: I ___ a cold because I slept with the fan on all night.
questions.e: Catch a cold = attraper un rhume.

questions.q: It's easy to ___ friends at the English Club.
questions.e: Make friends = se faire des amis.

questions.q: After dinner, I help my mother ___ the dishes.
questions.e: Do the dishes = faire la vaisselle.

questions.q: Can I ___ you a question?
questions.e: Ask a question = poser une question (et non make a question).

questions.q: The students ___ a lot of noise when the teacher left the room.
Which of these is NOT a vegetable?
questions.e: Mango (mangue) est un fruit. Onion, carrot et cabbage sont des légumes.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a job?
questions.e: Bakery = boulangerie, c'est un lieu. Baker = boulanger.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a part of the body?
questions.e: Pillow = oreiller. Elbow = coude, knee = genou, ankle = cheville.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a means of transport?
questions.e: Pavement = trottoir. Les autres sont des moyens de transport.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a feeling?
questions.e: Furniture = meubles. Anger = colère, joy = joie, fear = peur.

questions.q: Which of these animals does NOT live in the sea?
questions.e: Camel = chameau. Shark = requin, octopus = pieuvre, dolphin = dauphin.

questions.q: A place where you can borrow books for free is a ___.
questions.e: Library = bibliothèque. Faux ami : librairie = bookshop.

questions.q: A person who saw an accident and tells the police what happened is a ___.
The people who live in the same village or area form a ___.
The ___ of a country is the number of people who live in it.
A ___ is a person who travels to visit places for pleasure.
The money you pay to register at a school is called a ___.
questions.e: Fee = frais (d'inscription). Fare = prix d'un trajet.

questions.q: If something is ___, it happens very often.
The ___ is the land along the edge of the sea or a lake.
To ___ means to speak very quietly so that others cannot hear.
To ___ means to look at something or someone for a long time.
questions.e: Stare = fixer du regard. Glance = jeter un coup d'œil.

questions.q: If you ___ someone, you respect them and want to be like them.
If you ___ someone for a problem, you say it is their fault.
To ___ someone means to stop being angry with them for what they did.
When the teacher ___ a student, she says « Well done! ».
To ___ someone is to tell them about a possible danger.
A ___ is a short sleep during the day.
The ___ is the moment when the sun goes down in the evening.
questions.e: Sunset = coucher du soleil. Sunrise = lever du soleil.

questions.q: Our village has no electricity, so we use ___ panels on the roofs.
Speak louder, please. I can't ___ you because of the noise.
Lac Rose, near Dakar, is famous for its very ___ water.
questions.e: Salty = salé. L'eau du Lac Rose est très salée.

questions.q: The city of Saint-Louis is built partly on an island in the Senegal ___.
The famous Faidherbe ___ in Saint-Louis crosses the river.
questions.e: Bridge = pont. Le pont Faidherbe relie l'île à la terre ferme.
